sales_notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS building product search + support assistant. Currently using OpenAI for chat/embeddings; running into rising costs and opaque tail latency at scale. Evaluating Redwood Hosted as first migration step, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC.

POC summary: moved 3 chat routes (support, internal summarizer, code-assist) to Redwood Hosted. Basic feature parity mostly OK but noticed differences on system message handling and tokenization that change outputs for some prompts. Regression run flagged summarization drift and reranking rank swaps on short documents.

Customer asks: (1) compatibility layer / API wrapper to reduce app changes, (2) tooling to compare tokenization + scoring parity across model variants, (3) canary and fallback to current provider during rollout, (4) predictable pricing for Dedicated capacity and burst model for peak loads.

Quote from Maya (02/18): "We need a migration path that doesn't break our production UX — parity first, then cost wins. If we see visible regressions during canary we need automated rollback and metrics."

Procurement: procurement loop expected to start after POC signoff; security must sign SOC2 + SSO integration. Procurement has indicated target approval in May if POC regression <1% and latency targets met.

Notes for SE: run tokenizer parity check, push targeted instruction-tuning prompt templates, test prefix/KV cache for support flows, prepare Dedicated sizing estimates for 3 model variants and 2 traffic profiles.
migration_plan_summary: Phase 1: Hosted API POC (done) — validate feature parity, run regression harness, evaluate cost delta. Phase 2: Canary Dedicated deployment in customer VPC with capacity commit for 6 months; staged rollout by endpoint with automatic fallback to OpenAI for failed parity checks. Phase 3: Full cutover + optimize batching/quantization and enable observability dashboards. Key gating: regression delta <1%, SOC2 confirmation, agreed burst policy.
technical_requirements: Must support streaming responses, function/tool calling, embeddings parity with existing provider, SSO/SAML for console access, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, KMS integration for keys, data residency in US region.
procurement_notes: Estimated ARR range communicated (50k-200k). Customer prefers monthly billing for Hosted POC then annual commit for Dedicated. Legal asks for DPA + standard security addendum. Pricing deck shared (drive link).
